thread:
jen: Noticed onboarding sampleapp getting 429s + duplicate items when bursting pages. Repro below.
kai: Could be client throttle + retry ordering. Which SDK?
devon: JS SDK. It batches in 1s windows and the auth-refresh middleware will replay requests. If a page is served twice the app merges results and you get duplicates.
jen: Sample config: throttle windowMs=1000 maxRequests=30, paginator pageSize=40.
kai: Quick mitigation: inject a client page id header and ignore repeated page ids.
devon: Agreed. Long term: SDK parity for paginator (dedupe hook) and align default throttle/backoff across SDKs.
jen: I added x-redwood-page-id and duplicates stopped in my run.
ci-bot: devon opened issue devex/1609: "paginator idempotency + SDK parity"
kai: I'll add a short note in the onboarding README about burst-safe config and the auth-retry caveat.
jen: Repro steps: run 15 parallel workers requesting pages with pageSize=40 for 45s and expire key at t+8s to force refresh. Capture merged results and logs.
